text: The Andhra Pradesh Aadhaar (Targeted and Delivery of Financial and Other Subsidies, Benefits and Services) Act, 2023. ఆంధ్రప్రదేశ్ ఆధార్ (లక్షిత ఆర్థికపరమైన మరియు ఇతర సబ్సిడీలు, ప్రయోజనములు మరియు సేవలను అందించుట) చట్టము, 2023 Rules Regulations Notifications Orders Circulars Ordinance Statutes SectionsScheduleAnnexureAppendixFormsActdetails Act ID: 202343 Act Number: 43 Enactment Date: 2023-10-30 Act Year: 2023 Short Title: The Andhra Pradesh Aadhaar (Targeted and Delivery of Financial and Other Subsidies, Benefits and Services) Act, 2023. Hindi Title: ఆంధ్రప్రదేశ్ ఆధార్ (లక్షిత ఆర్థికపరమైన మరియు ఇతర సబ్సిడీలు, ప్రయోజనములు మరియు సేవలను అందించుట) చట్టము, 2023 Long Title: AN ACT TO PROVIDE FOR, AS A GOOD GOVERNANCE, EFFICIENT, TRANSPARENT AND TARGETED DELIVERY OF SUBSIDIES, BENEFITS AND SERVICES, THE EXPENDITURE FOR WHICH IS INCURRED ENTIRELY FROM THE CONSOLIDATED FUND OF STATE TO INDIVIDUALS RESIDING IN THE STATE OF ANDHRA PRADESH USING AADHAAR NUMBER AS SOLE PROOF OF ESTABLISHING IDENTITY OF AN INDIVIDUAL AND FOR MATTERS CONNECTED THEREWITH OR INCIDENTAL THERETO.
